description_en: Queries the top N domain names ranked by network traffic. You can query data collected in the last 30 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeTopDomainsByFlow获取用户按流量排名的域名，支持获取最近30天的数据
name: DescribeTopDomainsByFlow

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The value of StartTime must be in UTC. For example, if the local time is 00:00 on June 1, 2021, set StartTime to 2021-05-31T16:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

StartTime必须设置为北京时间0点对应的UTC时间，例如：北京时间06月01日0点，需要设置为UTC时间“2021-05-31T16:00:00Z”
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of domain names to query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 域名获取数量限制，默认为20，取值1~100
parameters.name: limit

DomainCount.description_en: The total number of accelerated domain names that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account

DomainOnlineCount.description_en: The total number of accelerated domain names that are in the Enabled state within the current Alibaba Cloud account
DomainOnlineCount.description_zh: 账号下状态为正在运行的域名总数

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried

TopDomain.description_en: The top N domain names ranked by network traffic

MaxBpsTime.description_en: The time when the bandwidth reached the peak value

Rank.description_en: The ranking of the accelerated domain name

TotalAccess.description_en: The number of visits to the domain name

TrafficPercent.description_en: The proportion of network traffic consumed to access the domain name
